title: Fixed twin R95 tri-star braked courier trolley with folding H1/H2 standing stow
problem_restatement: Provide courier trolley for 60kg plus 12kg parcel to climb 170R/280G with two-nosing contact, hold then brake-meter descent HSE compliant, fold in 26s to 850x550x260 standing stow fitting 762/726mm doors and van between arches, with sealed wet/gritty operation
mechanism_sentence: Twin fixed R95 tri-stars with six 100mm wheels maintain two-nosing contact to bridge 170R/280G stairs while the vertical 60x40x4 6061-T6 spine carries the bending moment and the CSK30 clutch plus R60 deadman disc holds 38.5Nm/405N then meters descent to 40.5N, with only H1 handle and H2 toe folding to 850x550x260 standing stow.
decisive_choices: FIXED twin R95 tri-stars with 6x100mm wheels for two-nosing contact on 170R/280G with 220R out-of-scope
SINGLE vertical 60x40x4 spine with full-perimeter 4mm ER5356 plus gusset and HAZ 25mm off peak stress
CSK30 110Nm SF2.86 plus R60 deadman disc to hold 38.5Nm/405N then meter to 40.5N with sealed 2RS
open_question: Physical bench still required to prove 60kg plus 12kg 60s hold 38.5Nm/405N no slip and deadman-metered 40.5N descent with no runaway and no over 150N spike across mu and risers, analysis-only not accepted?
transfer_line: Force: H2 toe -> spine -> R95 tri-stars | Measured: CSK30 -> R60 disc

assumed_constraints.constraint: Stairs 170R/280G diag ~328mm bridged with two-nosing contact; 220R diag 356.1mm frozen OUT-OF-SCOPE
Payload 60kg+12kg must hold 38.5Nm/405N 60s then deadman-meter to 40.5N with no runaway and no >150N spike
Track 420mm in 762mm door 342mm total and 726mm frame 306mm conservative; overall 550mm width
Folded 850x550x260 standing on toe+stars 0.12155m3 stows between 1392mm arches; fold 26s <30s one courier
HAZ design to ~103MPa/24ksi with full-perimeter 4mm ER5356+gusset HAZ 25mm off peak; van 10deg brake and 1.04Grms latched stow

functional_decomposition: bridge 170R/280G with two-nosing contact without jamming
fold H1 plus H2 in 26s to standing stow and lock for van vibration
fit 420mm track in 762/726mm doors and 1392mm between arches

concept.working_principle: Twin fixed R95 tri-stars with 6x100mm wheels bridge 170R/280G diag 327.6mm with two-nosing contact within 650D, SINGLE vertical 60x40x4 spine carries M317.8Nm with HAZ 25mm off peak, CSK30 110Nm plus R60 deadman disc holds 38.5Nm/405N 60s then meters to 40.5N, only H1 handle and H2 toe fold deployed 1200x550x650 to folded 850x550x260 standing on toe+stars in 26s

parts.name: spine 6061-T6 RHS 60x40x4
parts.function: carry 317.8Nm moment vertical 60mm depth peak away from weld

loads.label: 40.5N braked metered descent no runaway no >150N spike

measurement_chain.name: mu 0.25-0.6 wet gritty x 150 170 220mm risers bench
virtual-bench sweep no runaway no over 150N spike

fabrication_steps.description: Cut SINGLE 6061-T6 RHS 60x40x4 spine with bracket keying 60mm vertical orientation peak moment away from weld
TIG full-perimeter 4mm ER5356 plus gusset with HAZ 25mm moved off peak stress
Assemble FIXED twin R95 stars plus 6x100mm wheels plus CSK30 30x62x16 plus R60 disc plus sealed 2RS
Fit FOLDING H1 handle plus H2 toe hinges plus DESTACO 207-USS 2000N stainless over-centre locks shrouded pinch <4mm <50N

risks.risk: unbraked 405.3N runaway exceeds 150N spike and HSE sustain
risks.mitigation: brake mandatory with CSK30 110Nm SF2.86 plus R60 disc 1604N deadman plus sealed 2RS plus cleaning inspection

risks.risk: HAZ softening to 90-120MPa yield with 62.3MPa net-section conflict
risks.mitigation: vertical 60mm orientation keyed plus full-perimeter 4mm ER5356 plus gusset plus HAZ 25mm off peak, weak-axis 35.71MPa SF2.88 and impact 41.45MPa SF2.48 vs HAZ 103MPa

risks.risk: standing-stow tip beyond 10deg van-brake and vibration unlocking H1/H2 with pinch
risks.mitigation: DESTACO 207-USS 2000N stainless SF5.66 vs 353N 3g plus strap plus MIL-STD-810H Cat4 1.04Grms latched plus shrouded under 4mm under 50N

novelty_claim: Re-affirmed freeze with FIXED twin R95 stars plus spine versus FOLDING H1/H2 only plus CSK30 and deadman disc meter to standing stow

figure_spec.system_view: deployed 1200x550x650 vs folded 850x550x260 standing on toe+stars, FIXED twin R95 stars plus spine vs FOLDING H1/H2, door landing van with two-nosing CONTACT, no-text overlay
